item.title: Aviation Reports Its Near-Misses. Almost Nothing Else Does.
item.description: ASRS has worked for fifty years. Healthcare has tried to copy it for thirty and failed. The standard explanations (culture, litigation) are downstream of something more structural — and the structural answer says exactly where the model can travel and where it cannot.

item.title: Every System Has a Wolf Interval
item.description: On the ancient art of making imperfect things work together — and why every complex system hides a compromise that howls when you push it.
